name: usage-band
description: Band above the prompt: live prompt-cache countdown, 5h/weekly usage, context fill

compactSoonK.title: Tokens: yellow above (K)
compactSoonK.description: Context size in thousands where the token count turns yellow (default 90)

compactNowK.title: Tokens: red above (K)
compactNowK.description: Context size in thousands where the token count turns red (default 130)

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key or usage overage (default 60)

cacheShowMinutes.title: Show cache under (minutes)
cacheShowMinutes.description: The cache countdown appears once this much time is left (default 45)

rebuiltK.title: Cache rebuilt above (K)
rebuiltK.description: Cache writes in thousands that count as a rebuild (default 50)
